purpose: Test-only ownership and NFT approval verification on fresh dedicated testnet accounts
price_basis: Lowest positive integer accepted by ListingTerms; a codec sentinel, not an offer or valuation
fee_basis: FeeTerms accepts 0 <= rate <= cap < 10000; zero exercises explicit no-fee terms
fee_account_basis: Existing separate test operator; required codec identity, not a treasury designation
policy_version_basis: Lowest nonzero policy version accepted by ListingTerms
expiry_basis: Human must approve an absolute future nanosecond timestamp covering the entire integration window
generation_basis: Required first generation in the fresh-account runbook
funding_nonce_basis: Lowest valid U64 nonce; candidate for the first funding on a fresh deployment only
restrictions: No commercial listing, purchase, withdrawal or public approval-hook intake
Admission allocation and replay records remain retained without a completed-reservation release path
